subject: Quick check: is the October window and budget still aligned for Pilot?
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@finserve.com>, Priya Roy <priya.roy@finserve.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Redwood discovery - pilot goals & next steps

Hi Daniel and Priya,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through your latency and throughput targets for the payments reconciliation use case. Quick recap and the asks I promised: 

- Pilot scope: 1 model endpoint for batched invoice classification + embeddings for similarity search. Target: 10K daily requests peak, 200ms median gen time.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 350ms, cost per 1K tokens within the target you shared.
- Data controls: VPC-enabled private deployment or dedicated pool for PII.

Next steps/action items:
- Ben: send a draft MAP and SOW for review (attached).
- Priya: confirm who owns budget approval and the cadence (how approvals flow).
- Daniel: confirm pilot start window (you mentioned early October).

We tentatively reserved a week-of-Oct 11 slot for a short pilot onboarding if approvals line up; if that doesn't work we can shift. Please confirm the approval owner and whether the October window is still realistic.

Attachments: FinServe-MAP-v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0162

Ben — thanks for the summary and the MAP. Priya and I will review the SOW internally this week. Priya is the approval owner; I expect a quick pass on budget numbers and I should be able to confirm the October slot by end of day Oct 4.

I'll follow up if anything requires more detail.

Hi team — following up again as I haven’t heard back. If the October commitment is slipping, can you share the new expected approval date?

Two concrete options from our side:
1) Keep the week-of-Oct 11 slot and proceed with a narrower onboarding checklist (minimal ingestion + one test prompt set) — requires Priya's sign-off.
2) Move onboarding to Nov and we can push out the run-of-show to accommodate a longer procurement cycle.

If you want, I can put together a short decision checklist that Priya can hand to finance to speed approval (budget line items, success metric sign-off, and data control checkbox).

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Final check before releasing Oct slot — can you confirm priority?

Hi Daniel and Priya,

Looping in Marissa (solutions lead) and Vivek (sales manager) to help unblock if it's useful. We need one quick confirmation so we don't accidentally release the Oct 11 onboarding window tonight: is the pilot still a priority for FinServe for the Oct timeframe?

If budget approval isn't ready, please tell us the expected approver decision date and we can hold the slot for 48 hours. If priorities have shifted and this project is deprioritized, a short note that says 'on hold' is totally fine — we'll archive the MAP and touch base later.

To make approval easy, here's a one-click option we can send to Priya (DocuSign link): https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/FS-SOW-v2

Thanks for the quick reply,
